description: Traffic persistence, reflected by moving average and lag traffic, is the strongest indicator of congestion and should be prioritized in all decisions
Traffic demand varies by time of day, with peak hours increasing congestion likelihood
Traffic conditions should be interpreted relative to statistical thresholds (P50 and P75) to determine low, moderate, and high traffic intensity
Rainfall has a secondary impact on traffic flow and may increase congestion risk under high traffic conditions
When traffic indicators are below P50 thresholds, conditions are stable and do not require active intervention
When traffic indicators exceed P75 thresholds, active traffic management strategies such as signal adjustment and rerouting are required
